name: drawio2tikz
description: Convert one sheet of a .drawio file (a draw.io diagram, flowchart or mechanical drawing) into a coordinate-exact TikZ fragment for embedding in LaTeX, or for /drawio2tikz. Use when the user asks to turn a draw.io diagram/figure into TikZ, when a LaTeX figure must reproduce a draw.io sheet exactly (mechanical drawings, flowcharts, module layouts), or for /drawio2tikz. Drives scripts/drawio2tikz.py (absolute coordinates, group-offset resolution, edge anchoring to shape perimeters, waypoints, braces, FR->EN translation).
